exposure: history of adverse outcome in index pregnancy
outcome: Recurrent adverse delivery outcome (instrumental delivery, emergency Cesarean section)
Recurrent adverse neonatal outcome (large for gestational age (LGA), small for gestational age (SGA))
cohort: 424 women with consecutive gestational diabetes (GDM) pregnancies
finding: A history of an adverse outcome (instrumental delivery, emergency Cesarean section, LGA, or SGA) in the index GDM pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of the same adverse outcome in the subsequent GDM pregnancy.
mod_finding: History of instrumental delivery or emergency Cesarean section in the index pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of the same outcome in the subsequent pregnancy.
